Gender Pay Gap Reaches Historic Low in Public Sector

The gender pay gap has reached a historic low, with the public sector contributing significantly to this reduction. In Sydney's inner west, one suburb has the smallest gender pay gap, while in other areas, men earn 50 percent more than women.
